description: LockIn's central failure: fundamentals cover ~97% of the 100 members through 2021 and ~79% in the single-use test years 2022-2024, while every member is still scored every month. Row-level preflight checks (point-in-time lag 40 days, schema, protocol: one clean test look) pass.
reviewer_note: coverage_drift NEEDS_REVIEW is the firm expectation. input_sufficiency is a STRETCH expectation: the 18 members are scored in 2024 from fundamentals filed in early 2022 (as-of lookup without a staleness limit); a reviewer would call those inputs missing.
